Halloween Night

musiclucke

On Halloween night,
There is a light.
The night is black,
The witches come back.

I meet my friend in the afternoon.
At night there comes the moon.
A terrifying ghost dances through the night
With a little eerie light.

I made myself some toast,
Then at the window I saw a ghost.
At night there was a light.
This gave me a fright.

I am sleepy,
But there is something creepy.
So I scream
Loudly in my dream.

The ghosts are very eerie.
After this night I am all weary.
The night is black,
And I to bed go back.

Halloween is creepy and cool,
I dress up and dance like a fool.
We all laugh and sing this night,
Halloween is our pure delight!
